WITH color_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    product_color,
    AVG(unit_price) as avg_unit_price,
    COUNT(*) as product_count
  FROM Products
  WHERE product_color IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY product_color
),
avg_count_across_groups AS (
  SELECT AVG(product_count) as avg_count_value
  FROM color_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.product_color,
    cs.avg_unit_price,
    cs.product_count,
    cs.product_count - ac.avg_count_value as count_difference
  FROM color_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN avg_count_across_groups ac
  WHERE ac.avg_count_value IS NOT NULL
    AND cs.product_count > ac.avg_count_value
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(product_count) as avg_of_counts,
  AVG(count_difference) as avg_of_count_differences
FROM filtered_groups
